notes.title: NEWS #2 - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.notes:
Hello players,


We have some important news regarding our [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] company's future.



[h1]01 Welcome Back, Commander[/h1]
The game has been released. We also provided a series of updates after release, and the game is now rock solid with a very positive rating.
Unfortunately, the actual sales were under our expectations, and my partner and I had a lot of arguing regarding this, so we decided to [i]"part ways,"[/i] which brings me to the next point.
You can check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/



[h1]02 NEW GAME #1[/h1]
My partner will work on a new game without me. He will use the artwork I made for previous Chromosome Evil/Welcome Back Commander games, and he will also use the [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] branding for publishing, so even though we parted ways, we are still working together to some extent.
He plans on experimenting with co-op multiplayer within an extraction squad-based type of gameplay.
More details soon.



[h1]03 NEW GAME #2[/h1]
I will also work on a game, but I don't want to give out spoilers yet other than it will be a new IP with unique squad-based gameplay.
I will also be working on this one with a new partner.
In addition, this year, I will also try to focus more on our YouTube channel and make full playthroughs of our games with commentary.



[h1]04 NEW GAME #3[/h1]
In collaboration with [b]Real Heroes Studio[/b], we would like to announce a big demo update on [b]Desolated District[/b] on 27 April.
This is a fresh take for us since it's our first project as a collaborative effort with another developer studio. We have a minimal involvement rezumed to environment storytelling design, graffiti sprites, polish interface stage, design consultations, and marketing consultation.
The game is a 3D survival crafting with a nice magical touch within a Kowloon Walled City theme.
You can Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/



[h1]05 Lovecraftian Days Fest[/h1]
We would also like to announce that the  [b]Lovecraftian Days [/b]steam festival hosted by Fulqrum publisher has started, and [b]Welcome Back, Commander[/b], along with [b]Chromosome Evil[/b] and [b]Chromosome Evil 2,[/b] are participating.
To celebrate this, we put together a new trailer that highlights some of the Lovecraftian-inspired bosses you can encounter in Welcome Back, Commander.
Trailer link: https://youtu.be/1HYEjJh_0eU
Link to event: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/lovecraftiandays2025



[h1]06 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle[/h1]
For our hardcore fans who would like to support us in the future, we also updated our 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle with a discount on ALL our games:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29954/16_BIT_NIGHTS/



07 16 BIT NIGHTS Steam developer Page.
We have also established a Steam Developer Page for those of you who want to be notified of all our future official releases.
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/16bitnights







Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: NEWS - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.notes:
Hi,

We have BIG news and a call to action.


Let's start.


[h1]1. Main Project "Welcome Back, Commander"[/h1]

Well it happened, we remained out of funding at the beginning of this November but after serious consideration, we decided to push forward by using our personal economies which should allow us to extend development time until the middle of Q1 2025.

"Welcome Back, Commander" is set to have 2-3 hours of playthrough but high replay value and high production value. 

We are still in discussion on what the price will be but as a general idea, the game will cost a minimum 5$ - a maximum of 10$. 

[b]We also need to decide what secondary monetization to have, some possibilities are still on the table, maybe you players can help us out with a vote?[/b]

[h1]A.[/h1] we release the game for 5$ and if we get enough attention on the game we we will keep updating the main game version but increase the price gradually up to 20$ to cover development costs.
[h1]B. [/h1]we release the game for 5$ and we also add one supporter DLC for 30$, it will have MINIMAL cosmetic content but it will be 100% optional as in just for the people who enjoyed our games to support us and if enough support on this DLC then we will keep pushing free content on the main game.
[h1]C. [/h1]we release the game for 5$ and we add 3 content DLCs(extra maps, extra endings and other content) for 10$ each DLC.

[h2]CALL TO ACTION[/h2]

Meantime if you want to support us, smash that wishlist button like u love it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/

We hope to have it released in Q1 of 2025.




[h1]2. Collaboration with "Real Heroes Studio"[/h1]

So, a couple of weeks ago we met the solo dev from "Real Heroes Studio", he had a game called "Desolated District" in which we saw potential, and after some ideas exchange, we decided to help him out in his endeavors.

This will be an experimental collaboration for "16 Bit Nights". 
We will contribute to "Real Heroes Studio" with Marketing consultancy, environmental storytelling design, and some other minor investments.

If the experiment will turn out to have a positive outcome then we will consider investing in other small indie developers in the future.

[h2]CALL TO ACTION[/h2]

You can smash that wishlist button and find this magical open-world-survival-crafting game on Steam here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/ 

We hope to have it released in Q2 of 2025.







[h1]3. Overall situation[/h1]

2025 will be a very risky year for us and we need all the support we can get.

If you want to support us, smash the wishlist buttons for "Welcome Back, Commander" and "Desolated District", smash it like you mean it!





Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: DLC#4 - the final DLC is out
notes.notes:
Hey Players,


It's been a long journey for us, a hard road but at the same time a very pleasant one, we managed to make a creation out of passion that many of you enjoyed.


Milestones achieved recap
We had 5 content DLC milestones and we managed to reach 2 of them and some bonus ones.

Milestone 1 - DLC 1 - extra content, new balance, new weapons, and the addition of a basic crafting system. We released this DLC for free because you supported us on our release date so much that you deserve this and it was amazing to give something back to the community.

Milestone 2 - DLC 2 - map editor - we released this one based on player suggestions, we know that not many of you tried it out but we hope that the ones that did had fun doing it.

The rest of the 3 milestones were not achieved but...

BONUS - DLC 3 - Cheat editor - we released this one because we had a person who downloaded a third-party trainer with a virus + we had a few people who wanted to finish the game but found it to hard. 
This one was released close to the holiday so we thought it would be cool if we consider this our gift to you and release it for free.


Present day:

We now released our fourth and final DLC.


It contains a PDF file with the following table of contents:

[i]Part I
1.1 Reason for creating this game
1.2 What was our inspirations
1.3 How long did it take to develop
1.4 What are the core design elements of the game foundation
1.5 What went bad
1.6 Release results
Part II
2.1 Who is the ancient one?
2.2 What easter eggs did we hide in the game?
2.3 Which one is the canon ending?
2.4 What happened to the main protagonist's brother? (spoilers)
2.5 How many endings does the game have? (spoilers)
2.6 Is there a sequel?
2.7 Tips
Part III
3.1 Game scenario map[/i]

It's a post-mortem of Chromosome Evil alongside some Q&A regarding the game's official lore.

[b]DISCLAIMER: This DLC is recommended only if you are a FAN of the original game and/or want to support the developers.
[/b]



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810130/Chromosome_Evil__Behind_the_curtain/




This being said, after 2 years since the release, we have not seen any critical bugs that have not been fixed by now in the Bug reports and our funds are almost exhausted while the game sales are now pretty low, so sadly we announce this is our last update on Chromosome Evil.


[b]We hope from the bottom of our hearts that you had a wonderful experience with our creation and that this game that we leave behind will still make new players happy over time.[/b]



Now, the future is still bright, we are 15 days away from releasing the sequel and we truly hope that the the experience you had with Chromosome Evil will be doubled in fun within Chromosome Evil 2.

We are small indies so we have no time or funding for marketing and at the same time we don't want our creativity to be limited by an external publisher, meaning we rely on community shares and exposure so please [b]Feel free to share the news AND smash that wishlist button, smash it hard, aggressively, and with a passion similar to how we sculpt this game[/b]





https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529770/Chromosome_Evil_2/





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/16f164a8bc15313db5b8ed1708cd8b264b76d166.gif[/img]







[b]We are grateful for all your support![/b]









BEST FREAKING REGARDS,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: The Third DLC - Cheat mode/Trainer
notes.notes:
Hello players,

I am going to start this with a bit of bad news, unfortunately, the milestone & timeline for the third content DLC was not met BUT ... we almost hit 200 reviews and we have enough funding for a few more months of game dev during which we are investing our time in a new game project otherwise we risk to lose financial stability and need to quit game dev in favor of a day job.

[b]We also noticed that some of you downloaded trainers from third-party sites that can harm your computers so we decided to create our own trainer/cheat mode for you ...[/b]

And because the Holidays, Christmas, and New year, are soon here and you players have been amazing in supporting our little Game dev team, we decided that the Cheam mod DLC will be at the cost of NOTHING, yes, this DLC costs nothing, it is [b]free & safe[/b].


[b]This is a THANK YOU for all your support on Chromosome Evil, we really appreciate all your honest reviews & feedback so we want to give something back as our possibilities allow.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240370/Chromosome_Evil__Cheat_Trainer/

In order to play the cheat mode you need to:
1. download the first free DLC(the one with weapon customization mechanic) 
2. run the cheat DLC one time for download
3. open the game folder location and open cheat.exe

[i]We are now working to make the cheat DLC launch on the page but we encounter some confusion in depots and we await Steam support response in order to have the DLC easier to launch.[/i]

FUTURE:
As stated above we do [i]work on a game[/i], right now all information is available only for high-level people from our Discord community but in 2023 we hope to be able to start releasing official information to everyone. 
Also, [i]you are all invited to our Discord[/i] if you have any questions.

notes.title: DLC #1 got released
notes.notes:
Hey Players,

[b]The first DLC got released![/b]

This DLC is dedicated to all the fans that supported our game, your feedback & support not only made us motivated to work on the first DLC but also made it financially possible to release it for free.

What does it contain?

- [b]NEW WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION INTERFACE:[/b] yes we heard you, we noticed many of you want more customization for the equipment so now you will be able to choose the mod the weapons with scopes, barrels, and so on + it will also change the visual avatar of weapons.
- [b]NEW ARMOUR UPGRADE SYSTEM[/b]: yes, we heard you again, we now added a system that lets you have more control over the armor upgrade system.
- [b]NEW BALLANCE[/b]: because of the newly implemented systems we also had to adjust a large portion of the game balance to fit with the new additions.
- [b]NEW WEAPON/ FLAME THROWER[/b]: we received many suggestions during the private Beta test for a flame thrower and we promised we will add it after the release. Mission accomplished.
- [b]ABILITY TO CHANGE WEAPONS[/b]: yes we noticed that a huge amount of you wanted the ability to change weapons so we added it along with a new system for unlocking them. The weapons & mood schematics drop randomly on weapon crates and will immediately unlock them in the weapon crafting menu.
- [b]VISIBLE STATS[/b]: we now display some of the basic stats for each item in the Weapon/Armor menus, again this is based on the feedback we got although the main aim was to have players concentrate more on the tactical decision, not the numbers and that is why we preferred to make the DLC based on your feedback separated from the main game initial concept, which brings me now to the warnings section:


[b]WARNINGS:[/b]
- The DLC new system does not support the main game saves and the other way around
- The future UPDATES will be based on the new DLC system
- We did not change the initial inventory system from the main game build because many still enjoy that too

[b]News about future DLCs[/b]
Currently, we also hit the milestone for the second DLC that we will start work on as soon as we fix all issues based on your bug reports(if any) for the current DLC and have it solid.
The second DLC will contain a map editor but the price and final details are still not decided yet.


Thank you, players!

notes.title: CHromosome Evil is RELEASED
notes.notes:
Hey Players, ladies, Commanders & survivors,


After 4 years of splitting between a day job and our passion for game development we finally managed to release our creation: A squad strategy game mixed with horror elements where all choices matter.

Its been a hard trip, for me at least it flips between passion for the art of creation and actual obsession to make a game that I would like to play 
Because after many tests there is a risk of getting sick of the game, we made it in such a way that each new playthrough will have a decent amount of randomly generated content + multiple main paths but this being said we must add some warnings before you decide to buy it or not.

WARNINGS:
1.1 the game is unforgiving on tactical mistakes but can be easily mastered with a bit of intuition.
1.2 we tested the game and we also have volunteers that helpt us with the testing but because the game got so many mechanics and complex design some bugs may have escaped our tests so we ask for forgiveness and patience, post any bugs you find on the bug report topic and my partner Sadoff will fix them.


Please...

Please keep in mind that we are just 2 active people working on this project with absolutely 0 funding and we rely a lot on player support, so if you want to support us we would appreciate it a lot if you leave an honest review on the Steam store page so that steam algorithm helps us with future exposure that can finance future updates, DLC`s and the possibility of our team to keep making games.
Reviews are CRITICAL for us.



Thank you, gentlemen!

notes.title: Trailer is out !
notes.notes:
Hey, 
Halloween is near so we decided to release [b]Chromosome Evil Trailer. [/b]

It's been [b]3 hard years of development[/b] and we estimate [b]around 1 more year until the game is finished.[/b] Hard development indeed,[b] Real Time Strategy Horror game[/b] is something that sounded easy at beginning but soon we realized that for this type of game we don't have any real patterns to follow so we had to create our own, we took inspiration from "Xcom", "Darkwood", "This war of main" and "Dungeons & Dragons", [b]hard yes, but very satisfying to create it[/b], I must admit that at some points I was a bit selfish in trying to create a game that I want to play but could not find it out there. 

We hope that in the end, we will give you a[b] unique experience[/b] and that the wait will be worth it! 

Thank you guys for supporting us with likes, shares, and comments, those small actions you take fuel our motivation to go on, [b]THANK YOU![/b]
